title: GitHub 2FA Recovery Codes (pointer)
description: Pointer to the GitHub account recovery codes stored in the organization secret vault. DO NOT store codes in the repository.
retrieval_instructions: Retrieve recovery codes from 1Password (Vault: Security → GitHub → RecoveryCodes). Access requires security-team membership or admin approval. Record use and rotate immediately after use.
notes: DO NOT commit secret values into Git. This file contains metadata only and points to the secure store location.
